run_upload_gtest_main: run the upload_gtest.py script to upload a Google Test patch for review with auto cc
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main_function: review the main function that wraps upload.py and appends the googletestframework group to the cc line
refactor_main_cc_handling: refactor the main function cc flag parsing to support additional email group defaults
summarize_upload_gtest_script: summarize the upload_gtest.py script which passes all args to upload.py and adds a default cc address
